speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: Goodnight.

speaker: raj_koothrappali
text: He's coming. Screen saver.

speaker: howard_wolowitz
text: Oh, hey, Leonard, how was your date?

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: Bite me. Sheldon, how could you just sit there and let them spy on me?

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: They were clever, Leonard. They exploited my complete lack of interest in what you were doing.

speaker: howard_wolowitz
text: You should thank us. When future generations try to determine why your relationship with Penny crashed and burned, this right here is the black box.

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: What are you talking about, the date went fine.

speaker: raj_koothrappali
text: Dude, she said she wants to slow things down.

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: Okay, so, she said she wants to slow things down. It's like saying" I'm really enjoying this meal, I'm going to slow down and savour it."

speaker: howard_wolowitz
text: No, it's like" this fish tastes bad, so I'm going to slow down and spit it out."

speaker: raj_koothrappali
text: You being the fish.

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: I'm not the fish.

speaker: howard_wolowitz
text: Oh really, did you make a second date.

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: Well, we sort of decided to wing it.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Oh, even I know that's lame.

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: Okay, alright, let's assume your hypothesis. We went to dinner, we talked, we laughed, we kissed, where could I have possibly gone wrong.

speaker: howard_wolowitz
text: Think back, Leonard, the littlest things can set women off. Like, hey, the waitress is hot, I bet we could get her to come home with us. Or, how much does your mom weigh, I want to know what I'm getting into.

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: I didn't say anything like that.

speaker: howard_wolowitz
text: Good,'cos they don't work.

speaker: raj_koothrappali
text: They also don't care for it if you stare at them and hyperventilate. Sadly, that's my home run swing.

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: Look, everything went fine. I didn't even have to refer to my impromptu conversation starters. The woman across the hall is into me.

speaker: howard_wolowitz
text: Let's go to the tape. Look at her reaction to the goodnight kiss, no change in respiration, pupils un-dilated, no flushing of the chest.

speaker: raj_koothrappali
text: Nice close up, by the way.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Interesting, her jaws are clenched, no tongue access, clearly a bad sign amongst mating humans.

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: That's not a bad sign.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Please, you might as well have been two iguana with no dewlap enlargement.

speaker: raj_koothrappali
text: And the worst sign of all is, you're here and not there.

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: I'm not there because I'm taking things slow. Which, by the way, compared to you guys approaches warp speed. And take down that camera.

speaker: raj_koothrappali
text: He was a lot more fun when he had no hope.
